findings.description:
SimplePaymentChannel.claimTimeout() (src/SimplePaymentChannel.sol#23-26) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < expiration (src/SimplePaymentChannel.sol#24)

SimplePaymentChannel.settle(uint256,bytes) (src/SimplePaymentChannel.sol#15-20) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp >= expiration (src/SimplePaymentChannel.sol#16)

LongLivedPaymentChannel._requireActive() (src/LongLivedPaymentChannel.sol#51-54) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- state == State.Closing && block.timestamp >= deadline (src/LongLivedPaymentChannel.sol#53)

LongLivedPaymentChannel.finalizeTimeout() (src/LongLivedPaymentChannel.sol#45-49) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < deadline (src/LongLivedPaymentChannel.sol#47)

Low level call in PaymentChannelBase.withdrawPayout() (src/PaymentChannelBase.sol#75-84):
	- (success,None) = address(msg.sender).call{value: amount}() (src/PaymentChannelBase.sol#82)
